v3-beta-welcome.title: Welcome to the v3 beta
v3-beta-welcome.p1: We've made a backup of your database automatically, but making your own before you rely on the beta is never a bad idea. Data loss is not expected, but this is a beta, so it can happen.
v3-beta-welcome.p2: Please understand that this is a work in progress. There will be many style and functionality changes that happen very rapidly. When we change something, we've done it thoughtfully.
v3-beta-welcome.p3: We welcome suggestions, but we're already trying to contain our own scope-creep impulses. New features are unlikely to be added until after v3 is official.
v3-beta-welcome.p4: That said, we are very eager for bug reports, input on ergonomics, and feedback about what is confusing.
v3-beta-welcome.p5: We're very happy to entertain merge requests, but please first raise them as a feature request on Discord or GitLab so we can discuss it. Things are changing very rapidly behind the scenes and we want to avoid duplicated effort.

autoImport.title: Auto-Import
autoImport.description: Configure automatic book import from a directory
autoImport.explanation: Storyteller can be configured to automatically import book files from a specific directory. When enabled, Storyteller will set up a filesystem watcher for the directory and automatically import any new book files it finds.
autoImport.defaultImportModeDescription: How to handle files found in import directories. Individual paths can override this.
autoImport.defaultEpub2StrategyDescription: What to do when an EPUB 2 file is found during auto-import. Individual watch rules can override this. Copy mode always upgrades automatically.
autoImport.epub2BackupSuffixDescription: Appended to the original filename when creating a backup before converting.
autoImport.importModeDescription: How to handle files found in import directories. Individual paths can override this.
autoImport.importCollectionsDescription: Add new books to collections when they are imported.
autoImport.addWatchRuleDescription: Storyteller will scan this folder for new books.
autoImport.noWatchRulesMatchSearch: No watch rules match your search.
autoImport.addIgnoreRuleDescription: Storyteller will skip this path during scans.
autoImport.noIgnoreRulesMatchSearch: No ignore rules match your search.
autoImport.autoIgnoreRulesDescription: Auto-ignore rules are added by Storyteller when books are relocated, backed up, or removed with re-import prevention. If a book isn't importing, search here for its path or title.
autoImport.noAutoIgnoreRulesMatchSearch: No auto-ignore rules match your search.

scanControls.title: Library Scanning
scanControls.description: Scan your library for new files and changes. Scans check all tracked books and import paths for additions, removals, and modified files.
scanControls.scanNote: Re-reads all import paths and book metadata, even if files haven't changed since the last scan.
scanControls.cronExpressionDescription: Standard cron syntax (minute hour day month weekday). The expression is evaluated in the server's timezone.

skippedImportPaths.title: Skipped import paths
skippedImportPaths.description: These file paths have been excluded from auto-import. Books at these paths will not be re-imported during scans.

readaloud.title: Readaloud
readaloud.description: Configure where new readaloud files are saved when the input files were not uploaded through the web client
readaloud.cleanCacheAfterReadaloudDescription: Automatically delete processed audio and transcription files after a readaloud is successfully created. Saves disk space, but means a full restart is needed if you want to re-align later.
readaloud.clearCacheNowDescription: Delete all processed audio and transcription files across the library now. Original files are left untouched.
readaloud.clearCacheConfirmDescription: Delete processed audio and transcription files for every book in the library? This frees disk space but means a full restart is needed to re-align books later. Original files are left untouched.

audio.title: Audio Settings
audio.maxTrackLengthDescription: Audio tracks longer than this will be split before transcribing. This can help reduce memory usage during transcription.

transcription.title: Transcription Settings
transcription.description: Configure how Storyteller transcribes audiobook narration to text. By default, transcription runs locally using whisper.cpp. You can also use paid third-party services.
transcription.whisperCppDescription: Runs directly on the server hosting Storyteller. No extra setup and nothing leaves this machine; speed depends on its hardware.
transcription.googleCloudDescription: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text. Paid cloud API; requires an API key.
transcription.microsoftAzureDescription: Azure AI speech recognition. Paid cloud API; requires a subscription key and service region.
transcription.amazonTranscribeDescription: AWS transcription via an S3 bucket. Paid cloud API; requires AWS credentials.
transcription.openaiCloudDescription: OpenAI's hosted transcription API. Also works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint via a custom base URL.
transcription.deepgramDescription: Deepgram's hosted speech-to-text API. Paid cloud API; requires an API key.
transcription.whisperBuildDeprecated: cuBLAS 11.8 is no longer supported. Please update to version 12 or 13.
transcription.whisperModelDescription: The default (tiny) is sufficient for most English books. For books with many uncommon words, or in languages other than English, you may need larger models like small or medium.
transcription.whisperThreadsDescription: Change the parallelization level of the Whisper model. Can result in a massive speed increase when doing GPU-accelerated transcription.
transcription.whisperThreadsNote: It is not recommended to set both this value and the "Number of audio tracks to transcribe in parallel" value to a value greater than 1. Choose one or the other.
transcription.whisperThreadsWarning: Setting above 1 may reduce transcription accuracy but increases speed by splitting audio into chunks processed in parallel. Do not report bugs if you set this to a value greater than 1 and are not able to get a consistent Readaloud, only if you cannot get a consistent Readaloud even with a value of 1.
transcription.whisperCpuFallbackDescription: If you have a GPU variant installed but want to fall back to CPU transcription, select a CPU variant here.
transcription.whisperServerUrlDescription: e.g. http://192.168.1.19:8080 for the local whisper.cpp server.
transcription.whisperServerApiKeyDescription: Only necessary if your server requires an API key.
transcription.whisperServerDescription: Offload transcription to a Ghost Story server running on another, faster machine. Any whisper.cpp-compatible server works too.
transcription.bucketNameDescription: Amazon Transcribe requires files to be uploaded to an S3 bucket before starting the transcribe job. This is the bucket Storyteller will upload files to.
transcription.baseUrlDescription: You can use a custom base URL to point at a OpenAI-compatible service like a self-hosted speaches instance or a remote whisper.cpp HTTP server.
transcription.modelNameDescription: e.g. Systran/faster-distil-whisper-large-v3 for faster-whisper-server, or whisper-1 for OpenAI Cloud.
transcription.deepgramModelDescription: Can be any model the server supports, like nova-3, nova-2, nova, enhanced, base or whisper. Defaults to nova-3.

parallelization.title: Parallelization Settings
parallelization.description: Audio transcoding is single-threaded, and Whisper has diminishing returns on multi-core processing for a single file. Since Storyteller splits input audio into multiple tracks, it can run transcoding and transcription in parallel.
parallelization.parallelTranscodesDescription: Transcoding one track will use one CPU core
parallelization.parallelTranscribesDescription: Transcribing one track will use up to 4 CPU cores (when using CPU-based transcription)
parallelization.parallelWhisperBuildDescription: Whenever the Storyteller container is recreated (e.g. after an update), it will rebuild whisper.cpp. This process can be sped up by dedicating multiple CPU cores.

upload.enableMaxChunkSizeDescription: Only enable this if you're running into maximum request size issues with your reverse proxy or hosting provider.
upload.maxChunkSizeDescription: Default is 100MB, which is Cloudflare's maximum request size.

email.title: Email Settings
email.description: Configure SMTP settings for sending emails (invitations, password resets, etc.)
email.forceTlsDescription: Disabling this option does not disable TLS. By default, Storyteller will use STARTTLS to negotiate a TLS connection. If you have this option enabled and see an error about an incorrect TLS version, try disabling it.

opds.title: OPDS Settings
opds.description: Configure the OPDS feed for your library. OPDS is a standard for publishing ebook catalogs.
opds.enabledDescription: Enable the OPDS feed for your library. This allows compatible ebook readers to browse your library and download books. You can access the OPDS feed at {url}.
opds.pageSizeDescription: The number of books per page in the OPDS feed. Default is 25.
opds.formatDescription: Which ebook edition to offer for download. Readaloud epubs include synchronized audio (media overlays) and are large, and many e-readers (e.g. Kindle, Kobo) can't use them, so you may prefer the plain ebook. An audiobook is always offered when available.
opds.urlsDescription: Storyteller supports both OPDS 1.2 and OPDS 2.0. Point your reader at either URL below. OPDS 1.2 is the most widely supported. OPDS 2.0 is the newer JSON-based format.

updates.channelEdgeDescription: Every release, including alpha and experimental builds. Switching back to Stable or Beta will not downgrade you, you will need to manually install the latest stable or beta version.
